caption: This miso ramen features a rich, amber broth with tender slices of pork. Topped with shredded menma, sliced green onions, and a sprinkle of red chili flakes, it sits in a white bowl with a red rim, set against a dark, softly lit background.

segments_info.text: Dark wooden table surface with subtle grain patterns and slight sheen, appearing smooth and reflective.
The miso broth is golden-brown, clear, and glossy, holding thin noodles and garnishes in a shallow, rounded bowl.
Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, thin, and fibrous with slightly curled, translucent strands.
White ceramic bowl with glossy finish, red inner rim, smooth curved surface, subtle glaze reflections.
A white plastic spoon with smooth surface, slightly curved bowl, and rounded tip, resting in ramen broth.
